name: South Coast Plaza
description: South Coast Plaza is one of the most prestigious luxury shopping destinations on the West Coast, featuring over 250 world-class retailers including flagship stores from virtually every major luxury brand. Located in the heart of Orange County, this iconic mall combines high-end fashion, fine dining, and cultural experiences including an on-site performing arts center. The center is renowned for its exceptional customer service, including complimentary valet parking, concierge services, and personal stylist programs.
demographics: Affluent shoppers, Orange County residents, international visitors, luxury retail consumers
summary: Orange County's premier luxury shopping destination featuring over 250 high-end retailers, fine dining, and world-class customer service in an iconic enclosed mall setting.
